Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 🛰️ 12 Entry Points SSA Space Situational Awareness — Surveillance Network, Object Tracking Space Surveillance Network — UK ground-based radar and optical sensors. Space object tracking — 100K+ catalogued objects in LEO, MEO, GEO. Conjunction assessment — collision probability for managed assets. Re-entry prediction — atmospheric drag modelling. Sovereign debris catalogue alongside US SSN. EU SST and allied feed integration. Satcom Satellite Communications — Skynet 6, MILSATCOM, Protected Comms Skynet 5/6 fleet — sovereign military satcom backbone. MILSATCOM — protected, anti-jam comms for deployed forces. AEHF interoperability — advanced EHF waveforms with US constellation. Bandwidth management — dynamic allocation across theatres. LPD/LPI waveforms for contested environments. Ground segment — Corsham, Oakhanger, Falklands. Skynet 6 PARADISE programme. Space Control Space Control — Counterspace Operations, ASAT Defence Counterspace operations — defensive space control doctrine. ASAT defence — detection, tracking, evasion of kinetic/directed-energy threats. EW in space — RF jamming detection, signal intelligence. Orbital warfare planning — manoeuvre doctrine for contested orbits. Hardening, redundancy, disaggregation. UK responsible space behaviour framework. Launch Launch Operations — SaxaVord, Pathfinder, Small Sat Deployment SaxaVord Spaceport — Shetland, UK's first orbital launch site. Pathfinder missions — Lockheed Martin, ABL Space Systems. CAA Space Regulator licensing framework. Small satellite deployment — CubeSat, microsat constellations. Polar/sun-synchronous orbit capability. Automated range safety, flight termination. Environmental assessment — marine, avian impact. AUKUS AUKUS Space — Pillar II Tech Sharing, Allied Interoperability AUKUS Pillar II — advanced capability sharing including space technologies. SSA data sharing — bilateral/multilateral feeds. Common data standards, shared threat picture. Deep space radar — potential AUKUS-backed surveillance capability. Quantum sensing collaboration. Shared range infrastructure and launch cadence. NATO NATO Space — Ramstein Centre, Collective Space Defence NATO Space Centre — Ramstein Air Base, Germany. Allied SSA fusion — multinational space object catalogue. Collective space defence — Article 5 applicability to space attacks. Space as operational domain — NATO doctrine. Allied exercises — coalition space ops rehearsal. DPP space contribution. NATO space industry cooperation. SDA Space Domain Awareness — Space Weather, RF Monitoring Met Office Space Weather Operations Centre. Solar storm forecasting — CME, flare impact on satellites and comms. RF interference detection — anomaly attribution, jamming geolocation. Optical/radar tracking — UK telescopes, phased-array radar. Radiation belts, debris density characterisation. Operational impact assessment. Satops Satellite Operations — Fleet Management, Ground Segment Satellite fleet management — Skynet 5/6, smallsat constellations. Ground segment — Corsham SCC, Oakhanger, Diego Garcia. Constellation design — orbit selection, coverage, redundancy. Station-keeping, collision avoidance, end-of-life disposal. TT&C architecture. Payload scheduling, ground station pass coordination. Workforce Space Workforce — Cadre Training, STEM Pipeline Space cadre — specialist military space workforce.
